title: ResourceReport
description: The report of the number of Resources with similar characteristics of availability, type, service, location, etc that are available at a given time.

type.description: The type of the Resource. Lijst van ResourceType items.

status.description: The status of the Resource. Example: reserved, inactive, available. This field determines whether or not a Resource can be used. Lijst van ResourceHealth items.

service.description: The Mobility Service used within the Resource Report. Lijst van MobilityService items.

drive.description: Drive of the means of transport. Lijst van DriveType items.

location.description: Location of the Resource. Lijst van Location items.

meansOfTransport.description: The Resource's means of transportation. . Lijst van MeansOfTransport items.
